svg.title: What happens when you upload a document
svg.desc: Animated diagram: the browser reads the PDF with pdf.js, splits the text into chunks and sends them in batches; the Worker embeds each chunk with Workers AI and stores the vectors in Vectorize; then each page is drawn as an image and saved to R2.
svg.text: What happens when you upload a document
Settings → Documents → Upload. The PDF itself never leaves your browser: only its text and page images do.
each page drawn 1,200 px wide, plus a thumbnail
